spec: Task 005 stage 3a: reconcile(mesocycle, plan, logs, today) -> the whole plan re-projected, and the outcomes it acted on. Only projected cycles with nothing logged are rewritten, stamped with ENGINE_VERSION and last_write_kind engine; a user's rows are kept; a plan holding a newer engine's cycle comes back as given. The mesocycle supplies the deload multipliers only. Expected loads are exact decimals.

cases.name: Met continues from the load actually lifted
cases.note: 01 §3.4, stage 3 decision 4. Cycle 1 planned 40 kg and was lifted at 42.5 for all its reps: Met, and the next cycles step from 42.5 — 45, 47.5, 50 — not from the plan's 40.

cases.name: Exceeded takes two steps
cases.note: Every set two in reserve above its target RIR (5 against 3): the next cycle is two steps on, 45, then one a cycle.

cases.name: a rep short of target is Under, and hold repeats the prescription
cases.note: Stage 3 decision 3: 5 of 6 is Under even with no min_reps below it. failure_policy hold: cycle 2 repeats 40, and the block resumes a step a cycle from there.

cases.name: reduce_load repeats the prescription at 90 % of its load
cases.note: FR-3.11. 40 x 0.9 = 36 -> 35 on the grid; then 38.5 -> 37.5 and 41 -> 40, each rounded once from the reduced anchor, never from a rounded load.

cases.name: repeat_cycle holds every exercise in the failed cycle, not only the one that failed
cases.note: Stage 3 decision 4. The squat, under repeat_cycle, fell short; the bench met its target. Cycle 2 repeats both (40 and 60), and no cycle is inserted: the block keeps its length and its end date.

cases.name: failure against a planned reserve is Under
cases.note: 01 §3.4: RIR 0 logged when the target was 3. Every rep was made, and it is still Under: hold repeats 40.

cases.name: no RIR logged is Met, never Exceeded
cases.note: INV-03: a missing RIR is no signal. The reps were made, so Met, and the plan is unchanged.

cases.name: a missed session changes nothing
cases.note: 01 §3.4, stage 3 decision 4: cycle 2's day (2026-10-12) has passed with nothing logged. Missed is reported, and the block continues as projected — the 'skip' of the table.

cases.name: editing cycle 9's squat, then completing cycle 4, leaves the edit untouched
cases.note: Task 005's criterion, FR-3.14. Cycles 1-4 completed as prescribed. The user set cycle 9 to 70 kg; the engine keeps it exactly, projects cycle 10 from it (72.5), and stamps cycle 9 as its own write again.

cases.name: a pinned set keeps its load, and later cycles step from it
cases.note: FR-3.14: cycle 3 is pinned at 50. Cycle 4 is one step past it, 52.5.

cases.name: a locked cycle is never rewritten, and anchors the cycles after it
cases.note: INV-06: cycle 3 is locked at 50, under an older engine stamp that stays as it is. Cycle 4 steps from it.

cases.name: a user edit made under an older engine survives a newer projection
cases.note: Task 005's criterion, INV-06, 02 §7. Every cycle was projected by engine 0, and the user set cycle 3 to 50. Engine 1 keeps the edit, re-projects cycle 3's other rows and cycle 4 (52.5) from it, and stamps cycles 2-4 with its own version. Cycle 1, completed, keeps its stamp.

cases.name: a plan holding a newer engine's cycle is returned exactly as given
cases.note: Task 005's criterion, INV-06: the older engine yields. The log would have made cycle 2 two steps on; nothing moves, and no outcome is reported — the newer engine, on the server, reconciles instead.

cases.name: a cycle holding a logged set has started, whatever its status says
cases.note: Stage 3 decision 6, belt and braces. Cycle 1 Exceeded would put cycle 2 at 45 — but cycle 2, still marked projected, already holds a logged set, so it is not rewritten. Its own log (42.5, Met) anchors cycle 3 at 45.

cases.name: percent_1rm re-reads the e1RM from the session
cases.note: Stage 3 decision 4, INV-07. 85 kg x 5 at RIR 2 is an e1RM of 85 x (1 + 7/30) = 104.83. Cycle 2 at 75 % is 78.63 -> 77.5; cycle 3 at 80 % is 83.87 -> 85. The rule's 120 kg baseline is not rewritten.

cases.name: percent_1rm with no RIR logged holds its e1RM and says so
cases.note: FR-3.2c, INV-07: no RIR, no e1RM. The 120 kg baseline holds — 90 and 95 — and the outcome is marked open-loop.

cases.name: double progression steps from the reps actually done
cases.note: FR-3.6a in miniature. Cycle 1 asked for 6 at 40 and got 7: Met, and the reps continue from 7 — cycle 2 at the top (8), cycle 3 a load step and back to the bottom (6 at 42.5).

cases.name: a deload is re-projected from the new last working cycle, and takes no step
cases.note: FR-3.9. Cycle 1 was lifted at 42.5: cycle 2 is 45, so cycle 3's deload is 45 x 0.6 = 27 -> 27.5, RIR 3 + 2 clamped to 4 and marked. Cycle 4 resumes one step past cycle 2: 47.5.
